messages:
maria_support: :rotating_light: Escalation from Acme (ticket #4321). They say after yesterday's rollout the assistant stopped invoking tools reliably. When it does invoke, args are wrong. Reported after deploy c0ffee7 (2026-03-10 21:12 UTC) to hosted-prod. Customer pasted a short repro; I pasted it below. Putting this in thread so SRE/ML can triage.

lisa_support: TL;DR from the customer: 'previous model would call get_user(user_id) and return a JSON payload; now it sometimes returns plain text or calls get_user with name instead of user_id'. They confirmed this is happening across multiple prompts, not just one edge case.

maria_support: Repro (customer provided):

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-v2-13B-fn",
    "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Find user 1234 and return machine-readable info."}],
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "function_call": "auto"
  }'
```
Expected: function invocation "get_user" with args {"user_id": "1234"}
Observed (customer): plain text: "User 1234 is John Doe, email john@acme.com" (no function call).
Observed (alternate): function call but with args: {"name": "1234"} which breaks downstream.

deploy-bot: Deploy c0ffee7 -> prod-hosted completed 2026-03-10T21:12:07Z. Rollout percent: 100%. Release notes: "fn-calling: improved parsing and canonicalization" (note: release note shorthand).

kevin_oncall: Thanks, added this to high priority. Maria — did the customer tell us which SDK/version they used? SDKs sometimes add wrapper options.

lisa_support: They are calling via direct curl (above) and also via our node SDK 2.1.3. Both show the same mismatch. They tried pinning to redwood-v2-13B-fn@2026-03-09 (previous stable) and that fixed the behavior for them.

sasha_ml: Okay interesting. Two distinct failure modes: (1) suppressed function call (model returns text) and (2) incorrect payload keys. Could be model-side behavior change or small schema/metadata mismatch in the function spec packing.

sasha_ml: Quick checks I'll ask infra for: which model artifact was used in c0ffee7? Was there a tokenization or signature change between 2026-03-09 and 2026-03-10 builds? Also need the exact function spec we send to model in hosted flow.

kevin_oncall: Infra — can you confirm whether the function metadata (names/arg schema) was passed intact to the runtime for that deploy? If a transform step accidentally re-keyed arguments (e.g., camelCase -> snake_case or vice versa), that could explain wrong keys.

infra_note_by_kevin_oncall: (from infra logs) Configs for c0ffee7 show function metadata blob present. No obvious transform jobs ran at deploy time. Will do a checksum diff of the function-spec bundle between artifacts.

maria_support: Customer also included two raw responses: one plain text and one function call with wrong args. Pasted below (sanitized):

--- response A (plain text) ---
Assistant: "Here's what I found: User 1234 is John Doe, he joined 2019, contact john@acme.com."

--- response B (function call) ---
Assistant called function: get_user
args: {"name": "1234"}

maria_support: They said this started immediately after the deploy and pinning to the previous model resolved it. They'd like a timeline and a fix.

lisa_support: Customer asked for immediate workaround which we applied: pinned their workspace to the previous model version. They report that application is back to normal. They want RCA and timeline for fix.

sasha_ml: Repro plan I'm going to run locally: replicate exact curl (temp=0), try model variants redwood-v2-13B-fn@2026-03-09 and @2026-03-10 (c0ffee7). Also run with function_call explicit "force" and with schema variations. I'll capture raw model tokens and model event traces to see if the model emits a function token sequence or plain text.

sasha_ml: Hypothesis 1: a small tokenizer or canonicalization tweak in the new artifact changed how the model emits the function call sentinel, so the runtime's parser misses it and returns plain text. Hypothesis 2: the model weights or fine-tune introduced a behavior change in how positional args vs named args are emitted.

kevin_oncall: Also check routing: were customers routed to a fallback model variant unintentionally? If the fallback doesn't support function calling the behaviour would match.

infra_note_by_kevin_oncall: Verified routing table — no fallback configured during that rollout. All traffic was to the new artifact.

maria_support: Customer asked if this could be a billing/auth issue. They saw 200 OK responses from API and billed normally. No auth errors. Latency within SLO. So this is behavioural, not auth/billing.

sasha_ml: Action items: (1) I will run deterministic reproducer and attach raw model token-level outputs. (2) Infra to diff function-spec bundles in artifact and runtime packaging. (3) Deploy team to inspect release c0ffee7 changes (any text-processing helpers). (4) Product to draft notification if this is a regression. I'll tag updates here.

kevin_oncall: For immediate mitigation: support pinned the customer. We should consider adding an automated canary test that runs a few function-call prompts post-release to catch this class of regression.

lisa_support: Noted — customer happy with pin for now but wants an ETA on root cause. They flagged this as P0 for their app.

sasha_ml: Quick snippet of my local run (will paste full logs when done):

```json
// request
{"model":"redwood-v2-13B-fn","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Get user 1234"}],"temperature":0,"function_call":"auto"}
// response from new artifact (raw tokens):
"User" " 1234" " is" " John" " Doe" ...  // no function sentinel tokens observed
// response when pinned to @2026-03-09:
"<|function_call|get_user|>{\"user_id\":\"1234\"}</|function_call>"
```

kevin_oncall: That token snippet is telling — suggests the newer artifact's decode no longer emits the special wrapper tokens. Sasha, can you also check whether the runtime's parser expected the older wrapper format and missed a new wrapper?

sasha_ml: Yup will verify. If true, fix options: (A) change model packaging to restore sentinel tokens, (B) update runtime parser to accept both old and new wrappers, (C) add a shim that converts visible text that matches function patterns into function calls (risky). Preference: restore consistency at model packaging or update parser to be tolerant.

deploy-bot: Rollout history: previous deploy b33f9a2 (2026-03-09) labeled stable-fn. c0ffee7 includes file changes in inference/formatter.py (small refactor) per diff.

kevin_oncall: Sasha — can you confirm whether inference/formatter.py touched the code that wraps function-call tokens? If so that is likely the culprit.

sasha_ml: Found it: c0ffee7 refactor removed an explicit call to wrap function responses with the <|function_call|> markers in the model-side formatting layer and now relies on model to include them. Some models do, some don't — regression introduced by assumption. I'll open a PR to add the wrapper back into the packaging.

maria_support: Awesome find. ETA on PR? Customer wants timeline for permanent fix.

sasha_ml: I'll push PR in next 2 hours to reintroduce the wrapper during packaging. Infra will need to produce a hotfix artifact and a controlled rollout. If all green we can roll to prod within 6-8 hours.

kevin_oncall: Infra — please stand by for hotfix artifact build. Also let's add a canary test in CI that runs the exact customer repro and asserts the presence of function sentinel tokens.

lisa_support: I'll update the customer: pinned working, we have an identified cause (formatter refactor removed wrapper), hotfix planned, ETA ~8 hours, will update if anything changes.

maria_support: Customer replied: thanks for quick action, please keep them posted. They said pinning works for now. :thumbsup:

sasha_ml: Follow-ups (tracking):
- ML: PR to re-add wrapper and unit test (in progress)
- Infra: build hotfix artifact + deploy canary + verify repro
- CI: add canary test for function-sentinel presence
- Product/Support: email customers affected by the roll (we should query who was routed to c0ffee7)

kevin_oncall: Marking this thread resolved once hotfix is live and customer confirms. Leaving open for updates.

maria_support: Thanks all. Will paste PR link and hotfix artifact id when available.

(Reaction summary: :eyes: x3, :white_check_mark: once fix verified)
